Take Root was egress-blocked. The English quotes the Open Word Bible; every quotation was replaced by 개역 wording pasted by script, and a reference is `mined` only if a quoted stretch near the cited block is a substring of 개역 (checked by script, translators' own self_rendered flags demote, never promote).

Where 개역 words a verse differently from the OWB and the author's comment hinged on the OWB word, the verse was kept verbatim and the comment minimally re-pointed: Luke 5:15-16 ('yet' → the 모여 오되 / 물러가사 contrast), Ps 5:3 (two parts → 기도하고 / 바라리이다), Matt 6:9 ('the first word'), Matt 6:12 (죄, not debts), Matt 6:13 (악, not the evil one; doxology bracketed in 개역), Luke 18:13 ('seven words'), Matt 7:7 (continuing action), Luke 11:8 (강청), Acts 19:16 (개역 두 사람, so 'seven men' dropped), Luke 22:31 (까부르다 = winnowing), John 17:15 (악에 빠지지 않게), Matt 9:38 ('His harvest' absent), John 11:35 (shortest verse 'in the English Bible'), 1 Thess 5:18 (범사에). Native reviewer should judge each.

Mirror defects: Isa 57:15 is truncated in kor_old (eye-skip between the two 겸손한 자) — the missing words are self_rendered; Matt 18:22 reads 일곱 번을 일흔 번까지 (the English has seventy-seven) and is kept. 1 John is cited 요한일서 as in the shipped ko corpus.
